news.title: Embattled Republican Senator Blasted Over ‘Epstein Donors’
news.description: Photo Illustration by Thomas Levinson/The Daily Beast/Getty/Reuters Republican Sen. Susan Collins has accepted millions in campaign cash from wealthy donors and powerful figures linked to Jeffrey Epstein—an awkward revelation as she fights to hold on to her Senate seat in the midterms. Federal filings show that Collins and her political committees have spent years taking money from people with ties to the notorious child sex trafficker, including Jay Lefkowitz, the lawyer who helped secure Epstein’s controversial 2008 plea deal, and Trump ally Leon Black, who paid Epstein $158 million for “tax, estate planning, and other related services.” Read more at The Daily Beast.
